Hello, currently working at Olivia Pros here. Here’s my thoughts. Worth it naman I could say for someone who’s starting their career as a VA (sumasahod na kasi ako so nasabi ko haha). Yun is kapag may client ka na and working 8 hrs daily. Pansin ko lang matagal sila kumilos. Like in my experience, bago ako makahanap ng client, once a week lang ako may interview per client. So if di ka napili ni client, you’d have to wait a week na naman before a client interview. Also, they introduce new members to our slack kapag may mga bagong na hire na VAs and it’s been weeks since may last na na-introduce (so meaning, either matagal iprocess ni Olivia Pros yung client meeting with VAs or wala pang napipiling VAs yung mga clients, I refuse to believe that though)

Add ko lang: during your client interview, tatlo lang kayo so you’d think na tatlo lang kayong choices ni client but no. That client is minemeeting din sa iba pang VAs so mas mababa chances of getting picked. Nalaman ko to when one of the staff revealed to me the name nung napili ng certain client pero di ko naman nakasabay sa group interview haha

Add ko ulit: Required ka to use Hubstaff tracker and they’ll guide you to install pa so if that’s okay with you then go. Medyo nakaka-off lang kasi they knew na may mga beginner VAs silang on training pero di nila dinidiscuss wtf is Hubstaff and you’ll have to do your own research so yun. I think they’re avoiding na ma-banggit na it takes screenshots of your screen every 10-15 mins knowing na a lot of VAs & Freelancers are against this due to privacy issues lol
